reviewer_scope: Read only envelope(), bounded fingerprinted snapshot to git apply --numstat, and integration with previously reviewed core parser. No archives re-read, no subprocess or source execution, no publication and no edits to the inspected files.
findings: No new blocking defect found in the inspected narrow envelope and stdin binding.

Mail prefix is outside the returned diff blocks; the recognized final three-line Git signature is excluded before the last block is parsed. Raw added source lines start with + and therefore cannot masquerade as an unprefixed diff separator.
Git receives the exact in-memory bytes after size and SHA/Git-blob checks. The fixed argv uses --numstat without --apply, shell execution or an input path reopened by Git.
The original strict parse_new_file still owns regular new-file mode, complete hunk, byte count, no-newline and Git index hash checks. Prefix/footer acceptance alone grants no complete-source status.
limits: The envelope recognition is a bounded accepted format, not authentication or complete RFC email validation.

numstat success and diff-count agreement corroborate parsing only; they do not prove complete application semantics, repository ownership, parent patch synchronization or production/research acceptance.
Static review did not independently rerun the reported nine patch inspections.
